text.card: A red giant 3,160 parsecs away, 11 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 12, give 1.01 solar masses and 11.2 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,754 K at its surface.
